mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, which compresses discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.0% signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales below their 3-month moving averages signals a weakening consumer demand cycle, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are below their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 115.0), supply chain disruptions and reduced manufacturing output lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 115.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts above 2000.0 thousand units indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 2000.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0), labor market deterioration reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production below 115.0 and GDP growth below 1.0% annualized signals a deepening supply-side contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both INDPRO < 115.0 and GDPC1 < 1.0% annualized, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
